title: Binary modular multiplication state
statement: Let $\ell$ be positive and let $m,x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$. Define a sequence of pairs of vectors by starting at $(0,x)$ and, for each $r\ge0$, replacing the current pair $(u,v)$ by $(u+y_rv,\,Xv\bmod m)$, where $y_r=0$ for $r\ge\ell$ and multiplication by $X$ modulo $m$ is the coefficient-vector operation that shifts $v$ upward and adds $v_{\ell-1}m$.
